contests.title: Dike — Measure IO: Municipal pool financing

provenance.sourceOrg: Grundy County Iowa Commissioner of Elections
provenance.quote:
Shall the City of Dike, State of Iowa, issue its General Obligation Bonds or Capital Loan
Notes in an amount not exceeding the amount of $1,500,000 for the purpose of paying
costs of the acquisition, construction, demolition, reconstruction, enlargement,
improvement, and equipping of swimming pool and pool facilities, including parking lot and
related site improvements?

contests.title: Reinbeck — Measure IP: Fire station bonds

provenance.sourceOrg: Grundy County Iowa Commissioner of Elections
provenance.quote:
Shall the City of Reinbeck, in Grundy County, State of Iowa, enter into a loan agreement
and issue general obligation bonds in an amount not exceeding $4,000,000 for the purpose
of paying the cost, to that extent, of constructing, furnishing and equipping a new municipal
fire station?

contests.title: AGWSR Community School District — Measure IR: School improvement bonds

provenance.sourceOrg: Grundy County Iowa Commissioner of Elections
provenance.quote:
Shall the Board of Directors of the AGWSR Community School District in the Counties of
Butler, Franklin, Grundy, and Hardin, State of Iowa, be authorized to contract indebtedness
and issue General Obligation Bonds in an amount not to exceed $10,820,000 to provide
funds to remodel, repair, improve, and equip the high school, including science and family
& consumer science classrooms and heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC),
mechanical, plumbing, electrical, roofing, and site improvements; to build, furnish, and
equip a multipurpose activities/recess facility, including site improvements; and to remodel,
repair, improve, and equip the middle school locker rooms?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes up to $1.5 million in general-obligation bonds or capital loan notes for acquiring, constructing, demolishing, rebuilding, expanding, improving and equipping a swimming pool and pool facilities, including parking and site improvements.
Authorizes a loan agreement and up to $4 million in general-obligation bonds to construct, furnish and equip a new municipal fire station.

Authorizes up to $10.82 million in general-obligation bonds for high school renovations, including science and family and consumer science classrooms, heating and cooling, mechanical, plumbing, electrical, roofing and sites; a new multipurpose activities and recess facility; and middle school locker room renovations.
